EXT. SKARTARA VOLCANO – MIDDAY, OVERCAST

An eerie silence follows the battle, filled only by the dull roar of molten rock flowing down the mountainside.

Devastated, PLAYER slumps to their knees beside LORATH'S HEADLESS CORPSE. TYRAEL approaches to join them, head bowed in reverent grief.
Tyrael kneels beside Lorath, opposite the Player. Gently, he takes Lorath’s hands and joins them to rest on his chest.
Player tightens at the word "duty," anger breaking through grief. Tyrael remains by Lorath, quietly listening.
Boiling over, the Player pushes to their feet. They begin pacing, at a loss for where to go. What to do with the anger.
Tyrael looks down at Lorath's body. His friend.
Wearily, Tyrael pushes to his feet and crosses to the Player. He takes out the MOTHER'S PROMISE (dagger.)
Tyrael presents the weapon to the Player.
Player accepts, taking the weapon from Tyrael.
Tyrael places a hand on the Player’s shoulder.
